title: Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Atlantic City — Overview and history
body: Signature edition. Original Signature organizational framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Signature profile of Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Atlantic City: Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Atlantic City is a casino resort on the Atlantic City Boardwalk, opened on June 27, 2018, in the former Trump Taj Mahal building. Owned by Hard Rock International (Seminole Tribe of Florida), it holds about 1,971 rooms and is themed around music memorabilia, with the Hard Rock Live at Etess Arena hosting concerts and the Sound Waves guitar-shaped hotel tower.
